root_cause: The keyboard navigation for left/right arrow keys moves the date by one day without skipping disabled days (weekends). The test expects that from Friday 20 Nov, pressing ArrowRight selects Monday 23 Nov (skipping Saturday and Sunday).
repair_strategy: Modify the `_onKeyChange` handler in the Pikaday constructor to implement custom day-stepping logic for left/right arrows that skips over disabled days (weekends) by repeatedly adding/subtracting one day until a non-disabled day is found, using the same disabled-day logic as the picker (minDate, maxDate, disableWeekends, disableDayFn).
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can navigate the date picker without landing on disabled weekend days, improving operability for users who rely on keyboard navigation (WCAG 2.1.1, 2.4.3).
functional_risks: The change only affects left/right arrow keys when the picker is visible. Week navigation (up/down) remains unchanged.
The loop has a safety limit of 365 iterations to prevent infinite loops.
verification_requirements: The existing journey test (ArrowRight from Friday 20 Nov results in Monday 23 Nov) should pass.
ArrowLeft from Monday 23 Nov should go to Friday 20 Nov (skipping weekend).
Week navigation (ArrowUp/ArrowDown) should still add/subtract 7 days.
